description: The Torch alternative remains incompatible with general GPTJ adjacent-pair rotation.
trigger: Calling RoPE.apply_torch with GPTJ style on a four-or-more-channel head at a nontrivial angle.
expected_behavior: Use adjacent even/odd channel pairs, matching the newly implemented native GPTJ path.
actual_behavior: compute_sincos repeats adjacent coefficients, but the application helpers still call split-half _rotate_half rather than the newly added _rotate_half_gptj.

verification.description: Whole-parent search finds the direct apply_torch caller in tests/test_rope.py, whose active styles include only NEOX. Inspected attention paths use native apply instead.
verification.limits: External callers are not covered by repository search.

verification.description: Compared adjacent-pair and split-half formulas for [1,2,3,4] with angle 0.7; outputs differed.
verification.limits: Executed scalar formulas, not Torch or CUDA implementations.
